page.overview:
Who is Afro Girl?

Afro Girl is a 2nd grade student at Springfield Elementary School.

She appeared in the school bus for the first time, sitting next to Milhouse's Friend.

She is often seen at Lisa's classroom, once shaking her head after Lisa was cheering about the test. She also laughed with other students when Lisa was saucy to Miss Hoover.
